name: base-local
note: Step C-.40 (ADR-D01.40/.41) on the base puzzle (600-cell-Full, Jumble off), with no D02 state, on the build's own session fixture. Local is never empty: on the opening state it draws cell 0's turning region beside Global, as the second pane of composite frames, and its readout says that this is the default. Clicks in Global ask the host for a pick: a hit would re-frame Local on the selected sticker's cell (ADR-D01.41) and the corner click clears the selection; today the host picks only in Jumble (its retained view of the base puzzle stamps no sticker), so each click is a miss and Local stays on cell 0. A twist (J) and an undo keep both views on one revision. The drags then show the linked rotation as two-views does: a drag in Local and one in Global each turn both views; unlinked, each turns only its own view; linking again returns Local to the shared rotation.
